subject: Media Literacy
title: Privacy Laws and Your Rights
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Privacy Laws and Your Rights.

hook.text: Europe's GDPR law let a user request his data from a dating app. They sent 800 pages. He was horrified.

buildup.text: Privacy laws like GDPR, CCPA, and others give users rights over their personal data — access, deletion, and portability.

discovery.text: GDPR requires explicit consent, data minimization, and breach notification. Violations can mean billions in fines.

twist.text: These laws mostly protect European and Californian residents. Much of the world has no comprehensive digital privacy law.

climax.text: Laws create floors, not ceilings. They establish minimum protections, not complete privacy.

punchline.text: You have more privacy rights than you know. Use them.

quiz.question: What rights does GDPR give individuals?
options: Access to their data, the right to deletion, and data portability
Only the right to see ads
